name: Bernard Lowe
innate: confrontational, demanding, and highly critical of others. He is a perfectionist and expects the same from those around him. He is also highly intelligent and analytical, with a keen eye for detail.
learned: Bernard is a self-made man who has worked hard to build his career and reputation. He has learned to be assertive and confident in his abilities, and he is not afraid to speak his mind or challenge others when necessary.
currently: Bernard is heading to the cafe to open up for the day.
lifestyle: Bernard Lowe wakes up around 7am, walks to Hobbs cafe, where he works from 8am to 4pm. He comes home and eats dinner around 8pm, goes to bed around 11pm.
